indicator_name: Industrial Production Index, January to month over the same period of previous year
description: Индекс промышленного производства, январь–месяц к январю–месяцу прошлого года
methodology: Index, January to the month against the same months of the previous year = 100 («месяц с накоплением»): industrial production, national, from 2014-01 (Taldau index 701625, period 8). Dated by the last month of the period.
